title: Binding to the Other Side: The AT-Hook DNA-Binding Domain Allows Nuclear Factors to Exploit the DNA Minor Groove.
authors: Battista, Sabrina; Fedele, Monica; Secco, Luca; Ingo, Alberto Maria Davide; Sgarra, Riccardo; Manfioletti, Guidalberto
one_liner_zh: 综述AT-hook结构域介导的蛋白-DNA小沟结合，涉及转录因子与染色质蛋白，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅作背景参考。
abstract: The "AT-hook" is a peculiar DNA-binding domain that interacts with DNA in the minor groove in correspondence to AT-rich sequences. This domain has been first described in the HMGA protein family of architectural factors and later in various transcription factors and chromatin proteins, often in association with major groove DNA-binding domains. In this review, using a literature search, we identified about one hundred AT-hook-containing proteins, mainly chromatin proteins and transcription factors. After considering the prototypes of AT-hook-containing proteins, the HMGA family, we review those that have been studied in more detail and that have been involved in various pathologies with a particular focus on cancer. This review shows that the AT-hook is a domain that gives proteins not only the ability to interact with DNA but also with RNA and proteins. This domain can have enzymatic activity and can influence the activity of the major groove DNA-binding domain and chromatin docking modules when present, and its activity can be modulated by post-translational modifications. Future research on the function of AT-hook-containing proteins will allow us to better decipher their function and contribution to the different pathologies and to eventually uncover their mutual influences.
abstract_zh: “AT-hook”是一种特殊的DNA结合结构域，通过与富含AT序列的DNA小沟相互作用。该结构域最初在HMGA蛋白家族的结构性因子中被描述，后来在多种转录因子和染色质蛋白中被发现，通常与DNA大沟结合结构域相关联。在本综述中，通过文献检索，我们识别了约一百种含有AT-hook的蛋白质，主要是染色质蛋白和转录因子。在考虑了含有AT-hook蛋白的原型——HMGA家族之后，我们回顾了那些研究较为详细且与多种病理相关（特别是癌症）的蛋白质。本综述表明，AT-hook是一个赋予蛋白质不仅与DNA相互作用，还能与RNA和蛋白质相互作用的结构域。该结构域可以具有酶活性，并可能影响大沟DNA结合结构域和染色质对接模块（若存在）的活性，其活性可通过翻译后修饰进行调节。未来对含有AT-hook蛋白功能的研究将使我们更好地解析其功能及其在不同病理中的贡献，并最终揭示它们之间的相互影响。
